title: Việt Nam
subtitle: A journey from the mist of the north to the deltas of the south.

days.desc: Land in Hanoi and spend the day wandering around before heading out. Hanoi acts as a travel hub for the first half of the trip. Loads of things to do - but don't have to do all of them!
Trek through terraced rice fields, meet local Hmong and Dao communities, and detour out to Love/Fairy Waterfall below Fansipan.

activities.name: Mario Kart O Quy Ho Fairy Valley

days.desc: Row through Trang An's flooded caves and climb Hang Mua for the rice-paddy panorama.
Consider: Capella Cruise (waterslide, on-board cinema, poker room, kayaking etc) - £835 for 1 night 2 days family room(!!!!), £493 for 2 person room. All inclusive.
Base by the beach with a Hai Van Pass ride and time in Hoi An's lantern-lit old town. Flight lands in Hue; short transfer on to Da Nang.
War Remnants Museum by day, rooftop bars and bánh mì carts by night.
White-sand beaches, snorkelling the coral reefs, and sunset at the night market.
Fly back into Hanoi to connect onward — one last bowl of phở before heading home.
